assumptions.cost_scope: commission, spread and slippage as charged by the configured cost model; financing / swap / funding is not modelled
assumptions.return_basis: end-of-bar mark-to-market equity (bar close, before exit costs); first return measured from the starting balance
assumptions.trade_pnl_basis: closed positions, realised P&L net of commission

unavailable.annualised_return_pct: the sample covers 0.02 years at 24192 bars per year; returns over less than one year are not annualised (GIPS convention) — see total_return_pct
unavailable.calmar_ratio: the sample covers 0.02 years at 24192 bars per year; returns over less than one year are not annualised (GIPS convention) — see total_return_pct
unavailable.max_gross_leverage: no position was open at a bar close
unavailable.sharpe_ratio: equity never changed, so return volatility is zero
unavailable.sortino_ratio: no bar had a negative return, so downside deviation is zero
